expected_value_samples: b'Test data for quality 5 with more content to compress effectively\n'
docstring_samples:
CATCHES: decompression implementations that fail on alternative compressed encodings
of the same content — different compression levels or methods should all decompress to
the exact same original content.
CATCHES: Basic round-trip compression/decompression preserves data

CATCHES: implementations that don't properly use dictionary during compression/decompression,
or fail to preserve data integrity in dictionary-based round-trip operations — they would either
produce corrupt compressed data, fail to decompress, or return different data than input.

CATCHES: test mode (-t) implementations that report valid compressed files as invalid,
exit with non-zero code on valid data, or produce any output on success (test mode should
be silent for valid files — output indicates processing/decompression rather than testing).

CATCHES: implementations that don't detect duplicate --test flags
and either accept them silently or crash instead of enforcing single
command specification.
Test detection of multiple unused let bindings.
Test --fail flag causes exit code 1 when unused code found.

CATCHES: implementations where combining --quiet and --fail flags
doesn't work correctly (should suppress output but still exit 1).

CATCHES: edit mode that doesn't handle inherit statements, removes
the entire inherit when only some entries are dead, or leaves behind
empty inherit statements after removing all dead entries.
Test deadnix: skip pragma.
Test --mhtml long flag
Test error messages in quiet mode

CATCHES: implementations that ignore file:// base URLs when processing file
documents, fail to update href attributes with the new base URL, or don't insert
the base element correctly.

CATCHES: implementations that don't expand %ext% template in output paths or
use wrong extension for HTML format — the output file should have 'htm' extension
when using HTML format with %ext% template.

CATCHES: implementations that fail to embed <input type="image"> src attributes
as data URLs — image input sources must be fetched and embedded just like regular
img tags to ensure the form button displays correctly.

Golden files: form_action.golden -- includes embedded input image
Input: form_test.html with input type="image"

CATCHES: implementations that insert snip markers between ranges when
--style=snip is not specified, or that fail to display multiple ranges.

Golden files: multi_range_no_snip.golden -- ./executable --color=never --decorations=always --style=numbers --line-range=2:3 --line-range=7:8 multiline.txt
--no-config should ignore config file.

CATCHES: implementations that fail to generate PowerShell completion script,
generate incomplete/invalid syntax, or exit non-zero when requested.

Golden files: completion_ps1_full.golden -- full PowerShell completion script
In auto mode, plain text files should not strip ANSI.

CATCHES: implementations that don't reject invalid syntax N:-+M — the code should detect
the '+' character after '-' and return an error, not attempt to parse -+M as an integer.

CATCHES: implementations that fail to detect inverse-T junction patterns
(horizontal line with vertical line extending upward from center), confuse
inverse-T with regular T or cross patterns, fail to correctly determine entry
points for inverse-T cells, or render upward-extending lines incorrectly.

Golden files: inverse_t_junction.png -- output from inverse-T junction pattern.

CATCHES: implementations where isOneOf(char) fails to correctly identify
'*' as a point marker character, causing incorrect corner rendering in diagrams
that use asterisks at corners.

Golden files: point_markers_normalized.golden
Input files: point_markers.txt -- diagram with * point markers

CATCHES: implementations where isOneOf(char) fails to correctly identify
'/' and '\' as diagonal line characters, causing incorrect shape detection.

Golden files: diagonal_lines_normalized.golden
Input files: diagonal_lines.txt -- diagram with diagonal lines
--overwrite / -o overwrites existing output file.

CATCHES: implementations where multiple ProcessingOptions interact incorrectly --
e.g., verbose mode + encoding + tab size where one option clobbers another, or where
option initialization order matters. The PNG must match byte-for-byte to prove all
three options are correctly applied together without interference.

Golden files:
    combined_verbose_encoding_tabs.png.golden -- exact PNG with 3 options combined

CATCHES: implementations that hang or crash when stdin is closed during
installer prompt instead of handling EOF gracefully, or that fail to detect
EOF and propagate it as an error, or that show wrong prompts.

CATCHES: implementations that ignore tag filters and always edit the highest-priority
sheet regardless of tags, or that only filter correctly for the first tag tested —
filtering by 'ruby' should edit the ruby-tagged sheet, not the python one.

CATCHES: implementations that select the first writeable path instead of the
last (most local), iterate in the wrong order, or always use a hardcoded path —
per the source, paths are checked backwards to prefer the most local.

CATCHES: implementations that fail to parse tags arrays or treat tags as
comma-separated strings instead of YAML lists.

CATCHES: implementations that omit critical config sections (editor,
colorize, cheatpaths) leaving users with unusable configs — or that misspell
field names ('editors' instead of 'editor', 'cheat_paths' instead of
'cheatpaths') causing silent config loading failures.

CATCHES: implementations that don't support combining PadLeft() and PadRight()
in the same expression, or that apply padding in wrong order.

Golden files: padleft_padright_combo.golden -- combined padding test

CATCHES: implementations that don't correctly convert to MB/GB units, or that
use wrong decimal precision for MB/GB sizes (should be one decimal place).

Golden files: size_gb.golden -- WALK_STATUS_BAR='Size()' on 50MB file
Test that walk starts in the specified directory.
Test that flags don't cause immediate crash.
Test starting with absolute path.

CATCHES: parser regressions, incorrect tag generation, missing language features,
output format errors, and any deviation from expected behavior for each language parser
across 1665+ test cases covering all supported languages and edge cases.

CATCHES: parser regressions, incorrect tag generation, missing language features,
output format errors, and any deviation from expected behavior for each language parser
across 1665+ test cases covering all supported languages and edge cases.

CATCHES: implementations that fail pattern-based filename detection, only
support extension matching, miss Makefile without extension, or fail to apply
pattern rules like [Mm]akefile correctly.

CATCHES: parser regressions, incorrect tag generation, missing language features,
output format errors, and any deviation from expected behavior for each language parser
across 1665+ test cases covering all supported languages and edge cases.

CATCHES: parser regressions, incorrect tag generation, missing language features,
output format errors, and any deviation from expected behavior for each language parser
across 1665+ test cases covering all supported languages and edge cases.

expected_value_samples: b'TUI tool to visualize Git commit graphs'
docstring_samples:
CATCHES: implementations that fail to handle the first commit correctly,
don't show the diff for initial commits, crash when there's no parent, or
show incorrect file stats for the root commit.

Golden files: initial_commit.golden -- reference screen state

CATCHES: implementations where Escape doesn't dismiss the help popup, or
dismisses but leaves the UI in an inconsistent state, or where help can only
be dismissed with 'q' but not Escape (both should work).

CATCHES: navigation breaking down with a larger number of branches, incorrect
ordering when there are many branches to navigate through, or performance issues
that cause timeouts with more complex branch structures.
Test navigation keys don't crash.

CATCHES: Graph layout algorithm fails with very wide graphs (10+ lanes) — should
correctly assign lane positions to all branches without overlapping or exceeding array
bounds, drawing the fork connector (├─┴─┴─┴─┴─┴─┴─┴─┴─┴─┴─╯) that spans all 12 lanes
from base commit to all branch tips.

Golden files: wide_graph_12_branches.golden - TUI screen showing 12 concurrent branches
all diverging from a single base commit.
Test Bash code with no output.
Test long Python inline code.
Test --code=value syntax.

CATCHES: implementations that don't support class definitions in session mode,
classify class definitions as expressions/statements incorrectly, or fail to make
defined classes available for subsequent object instantiation.

CATCHES: implementations that don't support enum class (scoped enums) from C++11,
fail to enforce enum class scope rules, or have issues with explicit casting from
enum class to int - scoped enums must not allow implicit conversion.
